text:
Anita: Proposal — start a staged A/B for routing penalty functions using shadow scoring first. Idea: push lightweight parameter deltas to edge deciders, shadow-score a sampled slice, compare cost/latency + correctness signals before flip. Thoughts?
Rob: +1. Need a clear delta format and an apply/rollback playbook. Last time a big policy blob caused flapping.
Jia: We should avoid full-policy sync for every tiny tweak. Suggest compact delta encoding: list of changed penalty params with path + version + signature. Example:
```json
[{"path":"/penalties/geolocation/region_bias","op":"replace","value":0.85,"ver":437}]
```
Marta: How do we sample tenants? Random 5% vs signal-weighted? If we pick naive random we might miss high-p99 tenants.
Leo: Signal-weighted sampling sounds right — surface tenants with high recent p95/p99 for the affected route types. Also add control cohorts for fairness.
Anita: Good call. Proposal: 3-stage rollout: shadow (5% sample, signal-weighted) -> small ramp (10% deterministic tenant list) -> gradual (50% via auto-promote if metrics pass). Each stage has fail-fast SLA checks.
Rob: Define precise metrics and thresholds. E.g., p99 latency delta <= +10ms, cost delta <= +2% and correctness eval score >= baseline - 0.5 pts. If any trigger trips, automatic rollback.
Jia: For edge deciders, delta apply should be atomic per-decider to avoid half-applied rules. We'll leverage our existing config version pinning and a two-phase apply: stage->commit.
Marta: Also need a TTL on shadow deltas so stale shadow params don't hang around if the rollout is abandoned. Suggest explicit expiration timestamp on delta and agent-side garbage collection.
Anita: Agree. Add signature verification and signer metadata so deciders can reject unsigned deltas. We should also compute a delta checksum and store it in the policy push history for audit.
Leo: Observability — emit side-by-side scoring traces for shadow vs live for sampled requests, but redact embeddings/PII. Keep aggregated histograms and diffs and a small tail-sample of raw traces for SRE debug.
Rob: On rollback playbook: automated rollback if threshold breached + manual rollback button in Console that pushes a negative delta (revert) with immediate commit. Also add a fast path that tells routers to bypass decider if unstable.
Jia: Implementation tasks for infra: (1) delta encoder/decoder lib, (2) two-phase apply in decider agent, (3) sampling controller service, (4) telemetry compare job. I'll own (1)+(2).
Marta: I'll draft the SLA checks and alerting rules; include an on-call runbook for investigating diffs.
Anita: I'll write the RFC with sample rollout YAML and action matrix. Quick sketch for rollout YAML:
```yaml
name: penalty-tweak-2026-03
stages:
  - name: shadow
    sample: 5%
    sampling_strategy: signal_weighted
    expire_after: 1h
  - name: ramp
    tenants: [list-id]
    wait: 10m
metrics:
  latency_p99: {threshold_ms: 10, direction: up}
  cost_per_token: {threshold_pct: 2, direction: up}
```
Rob: Awesome. One more Q: how do we prevent two overlapping deltas from conflicting? Need ordering + merge semantics.
Jia: Deltas include base_version and conflict reject if base mismatches. For safe concurrent edits we can support simple optimistic concurrency with human review for collisions.
Leo: For experiments we might want to run multiple shadow variants simultaneously. Make sure score tracing supports variant tags.
Anita: Good point. We'll add variant_id in delta metadata.
deploy-bot: CI check passed for delta-lib PR #412 and staging agent build queued. :rocket:
Anita: Next steps: I will open RFC with examples tomorrow, Jia to start delta lib PR, Marta to draft runbook. Ping me with blockers. :thumbsup:
